question: What fifteenth placement involves placing the mantra letters on the back and the front?
premises: The mantra letters are to be placed on the back
They are also to be placed on the front
This is identified as the fifteenth placement
inference: Placing the mantra letters on the back and front constitutes the fifteenth placement.
plain_english: One should place the mantra letters on the back and in front; this is the fifteenth.
